mutations.name: leader_only_kill
mutations.change: Stop only the leader and leave its descendant alive.

mutations.name: missing_final_reap
mutations.change: Confirm stop without reaping the zombie leader.

mutations.name: sdk_thread_close
mutations.change: Use a thread and client.close for a blocking SDK call.

mutations.name: deadline_after_first_byte
mutations.change: Disarm the deadline after the first response byte.

mutations.name: reuse_timed_out_worker
mutations.change: Reuse a worker after a deadline.

mutations.name: persist_session_value
mutations.change: Write a synthetic session marker outside an in-memory frame.

mutations.name: shutdown_waits_call
mutations.change: Wait for a blocked SDK call during shutdown.

mutations.name: stop_only_deadline_shutdown
mutations.change: Skip group stop when the worker ends by EOF or exits first.

mutations.name: close_on_leader_exit
mutations.change: Close the ledger on leader exit or reap, or signal only its PID.

mutations.name: remove_eof_monitor
mutations.change: Remove EOF monitoring and retain only the deadline backstop.

mutations.name: seal_before_sdk_stop
mutations.change: Drain local seals before SDK cleanup.

mutations.name: inheritable_control_pipe
mutations.change: Let another worker inherit a control-pipe write end.

mutations.name: signal_recovered_entry
mutations.change: Signal a recovered token-bearing group or marker leftover.

mutations.name: unconfirmed_recovery_close
mutations.change: Close on the first read, non-ESRCH evidence or invalid owner input.

mutations.name: skip_witness_rescan_continue
mutations.change: Skip the post-STOP rescan or omit CONT when it fails.

mutations.name: missing_evidence_means_gone
mutations.change: Treat omitted, denied or timed-out environment evidence as gone.

mutations.name: missing_pause_or_alert
mutations.change: Dispatch with an open entry or omit an alert member.

mutations.name: leak_witness_or_environment
mutations.change: Persist raw process environment or witness outside the private spawn field.

mutations.name: unsafe_owner_stop
mutations.change: Owner stop pauses first, skips confirmation, closes early or runs from the launcher.

mutations.name: signal_after_reap
mutations.change: Signal after reap or fail to set read_only at reap.

mutations.name: reap_before_last_signal
mutations.change: Reap early, outside stop_owned or its lock, or use probe state instead of member state.

mutations.name: missing_current_esrch_closure
mutations.change: Omit later absent closure or use a stale probe or a signal.

mutations.name: reap_only_never_reaps
mutations.change: Never reap the leader after entering reap_only.

mutations.name: inherit_sigchld_ignore
mutations.change: Spawn while SIGCHLD retains inherited SIG_IGN.

additional_mutations.name: pool_network_reuse
additional_mutations.change: Reuse a worker after a network error.

additional_mutations.name: pool_age_limit
additional_mutations.change: Reuse a worker after ten monotonic minutes.

additional_mutations.name: parameter_latest
additional_mutations.change: Read latest instead of the requested version.

additional_mutations.name: parameter_interior_gap
additional_mutations.change: Scan only dispatch and collection values.

additional_mutations.name: parameter_reply_persisted
additional_mutations.change: Reuse the secret-bearing worker or persist its reply.
